title: [Empower] — Kill a friendly unit activated ability is not offered/does nothing
expected: Verified via getAllCards(): ven-124-166 (Escaped Grayback) resolves to a single ability — the static {condition: while-empowered, effect: modify-might +2}. The "[Empower] — Kill a friendly unit" line is dropped. Root cause at /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts:53-55 — the [Empower] keyword-cost regex only accepts :rb_energy_N:/:rb_rune_X:/:rb_exhaust: cost tokens, so a "Kill a friendly unit" cost never matches and no activated ability (cost: kill friendly unit, effect: empower self) is emitted. ven.json:3806-3808 has abilities:[null] and there is no hand-written src/cards override for this card, so the engine has no activated ability to enumerate or execute.
observed: No activateAbility move enumerated for Grayback at all (moves = endTurn/concede/rune moves only); calling executeMove('activateAbility',{cardId:Grayback,abilityIndex:0}) directly was a no-op (Flame Chompers still alive, no chain item, no empowered flag). Parser output for this rulesText contains only the while-empowered static (+2 might) — the `[Empower] — Kill a friendly unit` line is dropped because the [Empower] keyword-cost regex in riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts only accepts energy/rune/exhaust costs, not a 'Kill a friendly unit' cost.
